analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md and contains no executable code. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3). It adds a note at about line 583 on scheduler-prefill benchmark schema 5, covering the fields prefillChunkTokens and maxBatchedTokensPerStep, and says a measured engine built with different geometry fails the run. It also adds one row to the env-var table (head line ~1755) for DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS, mapped to EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift. These are benchmark and tuning knobs for prefill scheduling. They do not touch the coordinator wire contract (TB-002), key custody (A-002, A-003), attestation or App Attest authorization (TB-009, TB-011), or the encrypted prefix-cache storage and TTL/HMAC/salt posture (T-041). The base text I reviewed in units 2 and 3 is unchanged by the patch except at the two documented spots. The patch excerpt is truncated (patch_excerpt_complete=false). The tail of the env-var table and the changed code in EngineV2Factory, which is not supplied, were not seen. I cannot confirm that the documented env vars are not forwarded to launchd or that they have no security-relevant bounds. Based on the supplied text, they are documented as benchmark and prefill tuning only. Remaining integration question: whether the code adding the two env vars and schema 5 respects memory admission and prefill bounds (availability, T-010/T-029). That is outside this docs-only evidence. No threat-model assumption is invalidated and no threat-model update is warranted by this documentation change.
